Use Step 1 plus Step 2 only to establish chronology and identify which sampled frame first contains a stemplot; do not infer the data values from those coarse samples unless the text is fully legible. Then inspect Step 3's frame timestamps and Step 4's frame-level OCR results to select the candidate frame that shows the full unsplit stemplot most clearly. Reconstruct the data values directly from the visible stems and leaves in that selected frame, sort them if needed, compute the median and mode, and map the result to the closest matching answer option exactly as written in the choices. If multiple Step 3 frames are readable, prefer the earliest frame that is complete and unsplit; do not mix leaves from different transformed versions.
